observations: Walked the success path as document review: available exact package and compatible saved source/provider/project record precede supported-client verification and manual reinstall; check identity/version, one effective provider, matching resources and synthetic Skill outcome separately for each user.

Walked error paths as document review: unavailable tag, collision, ambiguous provider, missing resources or incompatible runtime stop the affected installation; preserve/reselect a verified compatible pair through supported controls, otherwise record unresolved failure. No silent latest, incompatible v3 downgrade or lock edit.

Unsupported/destructive/admin operations and additional affected users stop the affected action and require scoped reassessment. Workspace import/ref/policy/deletion, automated install, cleanup and remote actions remain separately authorized; no generic pluginId/delete-reimport workaround. Local qualified identity proves no managed continuity.

Original FIND-001 and FIND-002 observations remain in history; their earlier source gate is superseded by approved bounded scope plus this completed review and CHECK-002/003. Underlying native/managed unknowns remain in the pending register, without a native pass.
